Writing, talking, posting, reacting, inviting: every real exchange makes sparks fly. A post makes them fly according to who can see it: public, community or friends. The limits apply to your moves, never to your sparks: momentum, the Flame and events make more fly with each move.

Together, your sparks form your light, and your level is read from it: a mint binds part of it, so it lowers your level. A million sparks for level 100, and a trial every ten levels: until it is passed, your light waits. Twenty phases. Levels climb up to 499; the Ambassador rank opens them up to 1,000, and the Oracle rank opens them without limit. Each level asks for a little more than the one before.

A Meesh is minted by hand: part of your light is bound into it. That part depends on the coin’s number and on your current level: smaller when your level is low, whole from level 100. It grows by 30 % every ten mints.
The bound part leaves your light, and only that part: your level drops by as much. Your rank and your medals don’t drop. What you received stays received.
Every mint, every level reached for the first time, every great deed makes your glory grow. Glory gives you your rank.
Keeping your Meeshes makes your legacy grow, from the Purse to the Reserve. Spending them watches over the Flame or offers adornments.

From Gold on, the medal wears a ribbon; at Prism, its enamel turns iridescent.
Tap a medal: its card says what it follows, its material and why, and what’s missing for the next star.
Your language passport. A stamp lands when you have sent a message and received one in a language. It is private by default: you choose who sees it.
Twenty medals, one per precise move. Each one climbs seven marks, from copper to prism, as you make its move again. A mint never puts one out or brings one down.
It appears when the dream’s three acts are complete. It is a veiled gift: sparks according to your acts, glory, sometimes a spark bonus, a star fragment or a Vigil.
Numbered tiers in every family of actions. Reach the number asked: the tier is cleared and the next one opens.
Once a week, an alliance with an accepted friend, open from level 20 for both of you. If each of you does your part, the reward doubles. It also carries your journey a few strides further.
A spark multiplier. It lights up when you’re active in several families of moves these days: content, comments, conversations, tools, social ties. While it holds, every move makes more sparks fly.

The fire your ancestors entrust to you, tended each day by at least one move. Each day of Flame adds 2 % to the sparks of your dreams, up to 50 %. A Vigil guards it for one day away; once out, it can be relit with Meeshes for 48 hours.

Your glory grows and never goes back: it gives you your rank. It grows when you mint, when your light reaches a level for the first time, when you do a great deed, when you climb a joust circle, when you complete a journey. Your rank opens your light beyond level 499.

The week’s contest, open from level 10: thirty heroes measure themselves there under their joust names. Your sparks of the week set your place: the top 7 climb to the next circle, the bottom 5 go back down, and everything starts again from zero on Monday. The Friends’ Joust is always open.

The number on your ring, read from your light. It opens the dream (level 5), the joust (10), the alliance (20) and rebirth (100). It rises when your light reaches the next threshold, and drops when a mint binds part of it. Rebirth sets it back to 1.

Meeshy’s rare, numbered coin: part of your light is bound into it when you mint it. Keep it for your legacy, or spend it: a Vigil for your Flame, an act to change, the Journey Seal. The bound part grows by 30 % every ten mints.

Each night, your ancestors send you a dream in three acts, open from level 5. Each act you complete makes sparks fly; all three complete make the Offering appear. You can change one act a day with a Meesh.
Every real exchange makes sparks fly; together, they form your light. Your light makes your level and mints the Meeshes. The sparks received since the beginning stay received.

An optional rebirth, offered at level 100, five times at most. Your level starts over at 1 and your light at zero: it becomes a Spark again, and your legend enters a new Age. The sparks you received since the beginning and your highest light stay, and the joust and the alliance stay open. Your ancestors offer you a numbered trophy and glory. Your rank, your Meeshes and your Flame stay.

An eight-week journey in the land of a language, with 40 free stops. The acts of your dream and the alliance carry you a few strides; four strides lead to the next stop, which you claim one by one. The finished journey gives the journey cup.
The shelf of your trophies: joust and journey cups, rebirth and Flame trophies. A trophy brings nothing: it is kept and shown. You choose the order and who sees them.

From 10 to 100, every ten levels, your ancestors ask for a simple trial: mint a Meesh, fulfill dreams, hold a Flame, reach a rank. Until it is passed, your light waits; once passed, the level rises at once.
Rare distinctions, done in one go when you gather what they ask for. Each great deed makes your glory grow: the rarer it is, the more it grows.
+25 % on the sparks of your moves while your level is 7 or more levels below your highest light. It stops as soon as the gap falls back to 6.
The Meeshes you keep for your line. Six containers, from the Purse to the Reserve, shown on your profile. The legacy grows when you keep your Meeshes and shrinks when you spend them.
Everything the game shows, one by one: what it is, what it’s for, how you earn it and how to use it.
Eight rules, and the whole game fits inside. Meo explains them, Mee shows you the move.
